rows.note: Use this for a deliberate or systematic inquiry into facts, causes, or a case.

example.english: The police will thoroughly investigate what happened.
example.traditional: 警方會徹底調查件事嘅真相。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 wui5 cit3 dai2 diu6 caa4 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng3

rows.note: This is the casual all-purpose choice for looking into or checking something.

example.english: Let me investigate first; maybe the machine is just out of power.
example.traditional: 等我查吓先，可能部機只係冇電。
example.jyutping: dang2 ngo5 caa4 haa5 sin1 ho2 nang4 bou6 gei1 zi2 hai6 mou5 din6

rows.note: Use this specifically when investigating a crime or criminal case.

example.english: The police continue to investigate the case and have not announced the suspect’s identity.
example.traditional: 警方仲喺度查案，未有公布疑犯身份。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zung6 hai2 dou6 caa4 on3 mei6 jau5 gung1 bou3 ji4 faan2 san1 fan2
